text:
For a resort project, developers typically create a **brand longlist** spanning global hotel groups, specialist luxury operators, collection brands, and—in relevant destinations—all-inclusive specialists.

## 1. Major global luxury brands

| Hotel group | Brands commonly considered |
|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | The Ritz-Carlton, Ritz-Carlton Reserve, St. Regis, JW Marriott, The Luxury Collection, EDITION, W Hotels and, selectively, Bvlgari Hotels & Resorts |
| **Hilton** | Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, LXR Hotels & Resorts and NoMad; Signia may suit larger convention or mixed-use resorts |
| **Hyatt** | Park Hyatt, Alila, Andaz, Miraval and, depending on positioning, Thompson Hotels |
| **IHG Hotels & Resorts** | Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection and Kimpton |
| **Accor / Ennismore** | Raffles, Fairmont, Sofitel, Orient Express, Emblems Collection, MGallery, Rixos, SLS, Delano and Mondrian |

These groups offer powerful distribution and loyalty platforms and frequently accommodate resort, residential and mixed-use formats. Marriott explicitly markets both luxury and full-service collection brands to developers; Hilton’s luxury portfolio includes Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, LXR and NoMad; and IHG groups Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette, Kimpton and Hotel Indigo within its luxury-and-lifestyle category. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/luxury-brands?utm_source=openai))

## 2. Specialist luxury and ultra-luxury operators

Frequently considered where exclusivity, rate positioning, villas or branded residences are central to the business plan:

- **Four Seasons**
- **Mandarin Oriental**
- **Rosewood**
- **Aman** and **Janu**
- **One&Only**
- **Atlantis**
- **Jumeirah**
- **Shangri-La**
- **Kempinski**
- **The Peninsula**
- **Belmond**
- **Auberge Resorts Collection**
- **Montage** and **Pendry**
- **Capella**
- **COMO Hotels and Resorts**
- **Oberoi**
- **Taj**
- **Dorchester Collection**

These operators are generally more selective than the large franchise groups and often favor management agreements, flagship locations, extensive amenities and residential components. Four Seasons, for example, has a substantial resort and residence development pipeline; Aman actively develops hotels, resorts and residences; and Kerzner’s resort-oriented portfolio includes One&Only and Atlantis. ([fourseasons.com](https://www.fourseasons.com/residences/private_residences/in-development/?utm_source=openai))

## 3. Upper-upscale and premium resort brands

These are often better suited to larger key counts, group demand, family markets or projects requiring more flexible development economics.

| Hotel group | Common resort candidates |
|---|---|
| **Marriott** | Westin, Sheraton, Le Méridien, Renaissance, Marriott Hotels, Autograph Collection and Tribute Portfolio |
| **Hilton** | Hilton Hotels & Resorts, Curio Collection, Canopy, DoubleTree and selected Tapestry Collection properties |
| **Hyatt** | Grand Hyatt, Hyatt Regency, The Unbound Collection, Destination by Hyatt and Hyatt Centric |
| **IHG** | Hotel Indigo, Crowne Plaza, voco, HUALUXE and the conversion-oriented Noted Collection |
| **Accor** | Pullman, Swissôtel, Mövenpick and selected MGallery properties |
| **Radisson Hotel Group** | Radisson Collection, Radisson Blu and selected Radisson Individuals resorts |
| **Minor Hotels** | Tivoli, NH Collection, Avani and nhow |
| **Meliá Hotels International** | Meliá Hotels & Resorts, ZEL and INNSiDE by Meliá |
| **Other regional/global options** | Pan Pacific, PARKROYAL Collection, Dusit Thani, Centara Grand, New World Hotels & Resorts, Wyndham Grand and Dolce by Wyndham |

Radisson identifies Radisson Blu as an upper-upscale brand with a significant resort presence. Minor divides its development focus among luxury brands such as Anantara and Tivoli and premium brands including NH Collection, Avani and nhow. ([radissonhotels.com](https://www.radissonhotels.com/en-us/corporate/development-opportunities/our-brands?utm_source=openai))

## 4. Independent “soft brands”

For an owner who wants to retain a resort’s name, architecture and local identity while gaining global distribution, these are commonly shortlisted:

- **The Luxury Collection**
- **Autograph Collection**
- **Tribute Portfolio**
- **LXR Hotels & Resorts**
- **Curio Collection by Hilton**
- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
- **Vignette Collection**
- **MGallery**
- **Emblems Collection**
- **Radisson Collection**
- **Radisson Individuals**
- **The Meliá Collection**
- **Minor Reserve Collection**

Soft brands can be particularly attractive for an existing landmark resort, a conversion or a property with a strong destination-specific concept. Marriott specifically positions Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection and Tribute Portfolio as collection options for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai))

## 5. Resort-led luxury brands with strong regional relevance

Depending on geography, the shortlist commonly expands to include:

- **Anantara, Tivoli and Elewana Collection** — Asia, Middle East, Europe and African safari destinations
- **Banyan Tree, Angsana and Garrya** — Asia-Pacific, Middle East and wellness-led destinations
- **Gran Meliá, Paradisus, ME by Meliá and The Meliá Collection** — Mediterranean, Caribbean and Latin American markets
- **Rixos** — luxury all-inclusive, especially Türkiye, the Middle East and Central Asia
- **Kempinski** — Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia
- **Rosewood and New World** — luxury and upper-upscale projects with particular strength in Asia
- **Oberoi, Taj, ITC Hotels and The Leela** — India and selected international destinations
- **Dusit, Centara and Pan Pacific/PARKROYAL** — Asia-Pacific resort markets

Accor explicitly identifies Rixos, Fairmont, Sofitel, Pullman, Swissôtel and Mövenpick as applicable to its luxury and premium all-inclusive platform. Banyan Group’s resort ecosystem includes Banyan Tree, Angsana, Garrya and related brands. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/all-inclusive-collection?utm_source=openai))

## 6. All-inclusive resort specialists

For Caribbean, Mexican, Mediterranean and selected Middle Eastern developments, a separate set should be evaluated:

- **Impression by Secrets**
- **Zoëtry Wellness & Spa Resorts**
- **Secrets Resorts & Spas**
- **Hyatt Zilara** and **Hyatt Ziva**
- **Dreams Resorts & Spas**
- **Breathless Resorts & Spas**
- **Paradisus by Meliá**
- **Rixos**
- **Iberostar Beachfront Resorts**
- **Club Med Exclusive Collection**
- Selected **Marriott, Luxury Collection, Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, W and Westin** all-inclusive flags

Marriott currently allows selected luxury and premium brands to participate in its all-inclusive platform, while IHG lists Iberostar Beachfront Resorts as an exclusive partner. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/ResourceFiles/2026-fdd-document/2026-le-meridien-fdd-3-31-2026.pdf?utm_source=openai))

### Practical core shortlist

For an initial internationally recognizable resort RFP, a manageable core set would often be:

**Four Seasons, Mandarin Oriental, Rosewood, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, JW Marriott, Luxury Collection, Waldorf Astoria, Conrad, Park Hyatt, Alila, Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Raffles, Fairmont, One&Only, Aman, Anantara, Banyan Tree, Kempinski, Shangri-La, Grand Hyatt, Westin, Autograph Collection, Curio Collection, MGallery and Radisson Blu.**

The final selection should be based less on the nominal chain scale and more on **destination fit, achievable ADR, key count, access, seasonality, airlift, residential potential, owner economics, operator terms and territorial availability**. Industry classifications can also differ from a hotel company’s own marketing category—for example, a company may call a brand “luxury lifestyle” while a market study treats it as upper-upscale. STR treats luxury and upper-upscale as distinct chain-scale segments based principally on rate positioning. ([str.com](https://str.com/sites/default/files/2019-07/create-property-reports-english.pdf?utm_source=openai))
